assetCoverage.title: Coverage
assetCoverage.none: Nothing is scanned automatically for this kind of asset.
assetCoverage.reason.policy_disabled: an organization policy holds it (tool switched off, approval or scan window)
assetCoverage.reason.no_scope: the organization has no scope entry yet
assetCoverage.reason.tool_missing: no sensor has the tool it needs
assetCoverage.reason.tool_not_allowed: sensors have the tool, but their policy does not allow it
assetCoverage.reason.sensor_offline: the sensors with the tool are offline
assetCoverage.reason.sensor_outdated: the sensors with the tool run a version that is too old
assetCoverage.reason.no_eligible_sensor: no sensor can take the work
assetCoverage.reason.credentials_missing: an API key it needs is not configured
assetCoverage.reason.quota_exhausted: today's shared scanning quota is used up
